`stock_report.py` now flags an item as `REORDER` when what's on hand will sell out before an order placed today could arrive. The 6 is at the top as `LEAD_TIME_DAYS`.

I ran it on your current `inventory.csv`:

```
SKU      ITEM                       ON HAND  STATUS
CF-1K    House blend 1kg                  9  REORDER
CF-250   Colombia beans 250g             42  ok
FL-100   Paper filters x100               0  OUT
MG-12    Enamel mug                      18  ok
OT-1L    Oat milk 1L                     30  REORDER
TE-50    Breakfast tea x50               25  ok
```

House blend (9 on hand, about 14 sell in 6 days) and oat milk (30 on hand, about 45 sell in 6 days) are the two new flags.

- **Exact ties are flagged:** an item with exactly 6 days of stock shows `REORDER`, since it would hit zero the day the boxes arrive.
- **`OUT` still wins:** an empty shelf shows `OUT`, not `REORDER`.
- **Items that don't sell are never flagged:** anything with zero average daily sales stays `ok` unless it is empty.

There is no safety margin beyond the 6 days, so a busier-than-average week can still empty a shelf before delivery. Raising `LEAD_TIME_DAYS` to 7 or 8 would give you a buffer if you want one.
